_meta.purpose: Declarative spec of the SharePoint 'Contract Review' library + folders for the intake and batch-P/R flows. Use to create the structure by hand, or feed a provisioning flow / PnP script in-tenant.

folders.purpose: Reviewers drop a contract here; triggers Flow 1 (intake pre-review).
Parent for the P/R test corpus.
Matching human redlines; ground-truth source (paired by filename).
Precision/recall scorecards (numbers + clause refs only; no verbatim text).
Optional reference copy of review_profiles.json and component_types.json.

pairing_convention: A reference original and its redline share the same base filename (e.g. 'nference_dsa.docx' in Originals and Redlines). Flow 2 and score_redline.py pair by base name.
